name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.6 CHILFOS FIX06: the Jump Strike stays strong (bounded extra HP and posture) but is never the lethal hit on an enemy with a Posture System; a block or parry never loses HP; a Jump Attack parried in the air lands into Link's native recoil; a completed counter may chain one of the four combos; a Back Slice can be parried without cancelling Link's spin; the prompt sparkle under the posture bar and the point-blank spear spark are fixed. Chilfos (E_KK), Lizalfos and Bokoblin posture duels, Link posture bar.
